image.name: Rover Pipeline
image.description: Rover Pipeline LLC is a large-scale interstate natural gas transmission system connecting Marcellus and Utica production in Pennsylvania and West Virginia with demand markets across Ohio, Michigan and the broader Midwest. The approximately 700-to-713-mile system has 3.425 Bcf/d of transportation capacity, is substantially contracted under long-term agreements and is operated by an Energy Transfer affiliate. The canonical PortCo is Rover Pipeline LLC; ET Rover Pipeline LLC, BCP Renaissance entities and Traverse Midstream Partners are ownership vehicles, while pipeline segments, interconnects and the separately owned Ohio River System are outside the Rover company boundary. Ares Management owns a 32.4% indirect interest through Ares Core Infrastructure Fund and the BCP Renaissance vehicles, Energy Transfer reports a 32.6% economic interest through ET Rover Pipeline LLC, and ePointZero owns 35% through Traverse. Blackstone's 32.44% indirect interest was realized when Ares acquired its vehicles on April 28, 2026. Rover's separately attributable headquarters, founding year and Energy Transfer's precise initial investment date are not publicly disclosed. No later Rover-level sale or signed pending ownership transfer was identified through August 15, 2026.

image.subsector: Regulated electricity and gas utility platform
image.description: Puget Energy, Inc. is a Bellevue, Washington-based utility holding company whose core business is Puget Sound Energy, the regulated electric and natural gas utility serving western Washington. PSE is wholly owned by Puget Energy and serves approximately 1.26 million electric customers and 883,000 natural-gas customers across roughly 6,000 square miles in 10 counties. Puget LNG is a separate nonregulated subsidiary of Puget Energy. The platform is owned through Puget Holdings by BCI (20.9%), Macquarie Asset Management (15.8%), OMERS (23.9%), Ontario Teachers' Pension Plan (15.8%), AIMCo (13.6%) and PGGM (10.0%). No later sponsor transfer or signed pending platform sale was identified through August 23, 2026. Puget Sound Energy is retained as the regulated subsidiary and operating brand rather than counted as a separate PortCo.

image.name: Aligned Data Centers
image.description: Aligned Data Centers develops and operates hyperscale and build-to-suit data center campuses for cloud, AI, high-performance-computing and enterprise customers. Founded in 2013 and headquartered in Dallas, the platform reported 51 campuses and more than 6.4 GW of operational and planned capacity across the United States and Latin America at the July 2026 transaction closing. On July 21, 2026, an AI Infrastructure Partnership consortium led by Global Infrastructure Partners and MGX completed its acquisition of 100% of Aligned at an enterprise value of approximately US$40 billion. GIP/GIM and MGX are the current joint controllers; their exact percentages and underlying fund allocations are not publicly disclosed. Macquarie Asset Management-managed funds and Mubadala were direct owners before the closing and are preserved as former owners. BlackRock is shown only as GIP's parent, AIP only as the investment program and Mubadala only as an indirect parent of MGX. No later ownership transfer or signed exit was identified through August 23, 2026.

image.name: Clearway Energy Group
image.description: Clearway Energy Group LLC is a U.S. developer, owner and operator of wind, solar, battery-storage and flexible generation assets. Founded as an independent platform in 2018 and headquartered in San Francisco, Clearway currently reports approximately 13.6 GW of gross capacity across 27 states. The company serves utilities, corporate and institutional buyers, governments, community-choice aggregators and other power-market customers, largely through contracted generation. Global Infrastructure Partners acquired the predecessor NRG renewables platform in 2018 through GIP III entities. On September 12, 2022, TotalEnergies closed its purchase of 50% of Clearway from GIP, leaving GIP III and TotalEnergies as equal current owners. BlackRock is shown only as GIP's parent after the 2024 manager acquisition and Evergreen Infrastructure Fund has no Clearway ownership period. Listed affiliate Clearway Energy, Inc. remains a separate company. No later platform sale or signed ownership change was identified through August 23, 2026.

image.name: Environmental 360 Solutions
image.description: Environmental 360 Solutions is a North American waste-management and environmental-infrastructure platform serving municipal, commercial and industrial customers. Founded in 2018 and headquartered in Aurora, Ontario, E360S provides collection, transfer, recycling, special and liquid waste, emergency response and industrial-cleaning services. Current company materials report more than 800,000 customers across Alberta, British Columbia, Ontario, Quebec, Saskatchewan and Michigan. BlackRock Global Infrastructure Fund IV closed a majority acquisition on February 16, 2023. Founder Donato Ardellini retained a significant stake and Canadian Business Growth Fund retained and increased its minority position; exact percentages are not publicly disclosed. OPTrust and Oaktree exited at the 2023 closing. BlackRock's acquisition of GIP did not create a separate GIP ownership period. E360S entered the United States through a Michigan acquisition announced in July 2026, and no later platform sale or signed exit was identified through August 23, 2026.

image.name: Eolian
image.subsector: Renewable project development and battery storage
image.description: Eolian is a U.S. renewable-power and battery-storage investment, development and operating platform formed in 2020 from MAP Energy's renewable business. It develops, funds, owns and operates utility-scale battery storage, finances renewable projects and retains operating-project royalties while serving utilities, independent power producers, wholesale markets and large industrial and data-center loads. GIP reports operating-project royalties across 19 GW, while Eolian reports nearly 30 GW cumulatively funded or developed; neither figure represents wholly owned capacity. GIP IV acquired MAP RE/ES in 2020 and GIP continues to classify Eolian as unrealized. Eolian's July 2026 Flint Grid announcement identifies employees and GIP-managed funds as current owners. BlackRock's 2024 acquisition of the GIP manager did not create a separate Eolian ownership period. Eolian is the counted platform; Astral and project SPVs are underlying assets, and the 2021 Able Grid transaction concerned development-portfolio interests rather than Able Grid itself.

image.name: Gigapower
image.description: Gigapower, LLC is a U.S. wholesale open-access fiber platform formed as a 50/50 joint venture between AT&T and a BlackRock-origin infrastructure vehicle. The company builds, owns and operates multi-gigabit fiber networks that multiple internet service providers can use to serve homes and businesses outside AT&T's traditional wireline footprint. Regulatory filings identify AT&T-related Infrastructure Endeavors Holdings, LLC and Teleport Communications America, LLC as holding an aggregate 50% interest and BGIF IV Neon Acquisition LP as holding the other 50%. The predecessor entity formed in Delaware in February 2022, changed its name to Gigapower in March 2022, and the joint venture closed and launched in May 2023. Current disclosures describe availability or expansion in Florida, New Mexico, northeastern Pennsylvania, North Carolina, South Carolina and southeastern Minnesota, with a long-term target of roughly 1.5 million customer locations. GIP, part of BlackRock, is now referenced as the fund manager, but no separate asset-level transfer or second GIP ownership period was disclosed.

image.description: Portland Natural Gas Transmission System is a standalone FERC-regulated natural-gas transmission business serving New England and Atlantic Canada. The approximately 295-mile system crosses New Hampshire, Maine and Massachusetts, connects with Canadian pipelines and has nearly 460,000 dekatherms per day of capacity. Its customers include utilities, energy marketers, industrial users and power generators. BlackRock- and Morgan Stanley Infrastructure Partners-managed funds announced the acquisition from TC Energy and Énergir on March 4, 2024 and closed it on August 15, 2024 for approximately US$1.14 billion including assumed notes. Regulatory evidence identifies BlackRock Global Infrastructure Fund IV and North Haven Infrastructure Partners III as equal 50% indirect owners through Beehive Loop AcquisitionCo LLC. The former owners' 61.7% and 38.3% direct interests ended at closing. PNGTS maintains a corporate office in Houston and an operating office in Lancaster, New Hampshire. No later company sale or signed pending exit was identified through August 23, 2026.

image.name: Revolution Wind & South Fork Wind
image.description: Revolution Wind & South Fork Wind is a paired manager-level record for two separate contracted U.S. offshore-wind project companies: Revolution Wind, LLC and South Fork Wind, LLC. South Fork is a 132 MW, 12-turbine project serving Long Island that entered commercial operation on March 14, 2024. Revolution is a 704 MW, 65-turbine project serving Rhode Island and Connecticut; it first delivered power on March 13, 2026 and was more than 95% complete in August 2026. GIP IV Whale/designated affiliates acquired Eversource's 50% interests in both projects on September 30, 2024, with Skyborn Renewables managing those interests. Ørsted retains the other 50% of each project, and Eversource is retained as the former 50% partner. BlackRock's acquisition of GIP closed after the project transaction and did not create a separate BlackRock ownership period. No later sale or signed pending exit was identified through August 23, 2026.
